title: 第六章 导师有任务
slug: 网游之剑刃舞者全本免费-网游之剑刃舞者最新章节列表
content_zh:
9点钟，一缕阳光不偏不倚地照射在林铮脸上，林铮皱了皱眉头，打着哈欠从床上爬了起来。“是了，哥们儿现在也算是有工作的任务了，尽管是个业余的，不过懒觉是睡不成了！”
提起精神，林铮走向了洗手间，不巧，某货也在。“你昨晚几点睡的啊？这么快就起来了！”林铮有些惊讶地说道。
“5点整！”杨琪口齿不清地刷着牙道。
“才睡四个小时啊！你也不怕英年早逝了！”林铮挤出牙膏，也刷起牙。
“游戏前期嘛，后面就能多休息一点了，现在是冲级最要紧，等级高了才有优势啊！我又不是你这种业余的，要考虑最大收益啊！”
“唔——我是不管那么多了，该睡觉就睡觉，话说，熬了一晚上，你几级了？”
“18级，那把黑鸦剑真是太给力，不然我还升不了这么高！”说道黑鸦剑，杨琪又兴奋了，现阶段绝对是神器啊！
“该死的，升这么快，难道这就是职业与业余的差距？”林铮有点被打击到了，他可才12级，算起来也就比杨琪少玩了那么一个多小时，居然有6级的差距，这不科学！
“我还不算快的了，那个虫虫才叫一个彪悍，居然21了，靠了！我可是有黑鸦剑啊！难道那家伙还有比黑鸦剑牛的武器？”杨琪一脸的迷惑，想不通那个虫虫怎么能升级那么快，不过很快又释然了，既然林铮都有运气打到黑鸦剑，这天底下有运气的又不止一个。洗漱好，两人简单地跑了下面填肚子，然后便又上线去了。
刚一上线，杨琪便联系林铮了。
“神棍，要不要姐姐带你升级？”她知道林铮才12级，自己18级了，又有黑鸦剑在手，带上林铮几级是很简单是事情，不过相对的自己升级就会慢点了。林铮也想到了这点，他自己只算是业余的，为了打金币赚钱这个简单的目的进游戏的，话说级数升得慢点也无所谓，而杨琪可不简单地是为了打金币啊！于是林铮拒绝道：“算了，你自己练着吧，我就不去拖你后腿了，等玩家的级数稳定点了你再带带我吧，你先把级数练上去再说。对了，你在哪啊？”
“仓库这里，有什么事？”
“刚巧我也要过去，等等我啊！我有好多金币啊！先支援你吧，以后可要加倍还我哦！”林铮笑道。按林铮想来，身上的金币他暂时是花不完了，与其留着发霉贬值，不如支援一下杨琪，等杨琪发达了他也会跟着沾光啊！杨琪现在穷得响叮当，一听有钱立刻是两眼发光，等林铮赶到仓库交易给杨琪40个金币时，就不是两眼发光而是两眼发直了！
“靠了！你小子哪来这么多钱啊！？”杨琪吃惊道，难道道具任务给的奖励真的这么逆天？那可只是个新手村的道具任务啊！却忘了林铮和她讲的，任务成了复合任务了，奖励也跟着难度产生了不小的变化。不过有钱的感觉真好！杨琪马上又眉开眼笑，有40个金币傍身，这升起级来会简单不少，安全不少！
“有钱你就拿吧，这么多话，不过话说，12级到什么地方练级比较好？”林铮一边交钱申请仓库一边问道。
“12级的话出了城门到清风森林就行了！不过，小心点，那边pk的人可不少，你挑个少点人的地方吧！”
“这才几级啊就有人没事pk，这不闲着蛋疼嘛！”林铮听着有些无语，死一次掉一级，你说那些pk的家伙怎么就那么闲。林铮是不会了解pk党的心思了，和杨琪道别后他便前往了职业大厅，昨天实在太晚了，连职业导师都没找就下线了，现在技能都还没学呢。
按着地图来到职业大厅门前，看着眼前这巍峨的建筑林铮还真的有点惊叹！全部是用汉白玉建造的啊！这要是在现实里面，光这汉白玉就够很多富豪倾家荡产的了！而到了游戏里面，眼前的那就是一堆数据。
踏着洁白的阶梯走进大厅，眼前热闹的景象让林铮以为自己到了人才市场。而不少“面试”的人那是一脸沮丧地从职业导师面前离开，也有人高高兴兴地拿着武器离开了大厅。听着那些沮丧的人口中的怨言，林铮总算了解到，果然到哪里没钱都是寸步难行！还有穷得连技能都学不起的啊！林铮为自己赚到的金币而感到庆幸！

content_en:
At 9 o'clock, a ray of sunshine shone impartially on Lin Zheng's face. Lin Zheng frowned, yawned and got up from the bed. "Yes, buddy, I have a job now. Even though I am a part-timer, I can't sleep because I'm lazy!"
Picking up his spirits, Lin Zheng walked to the bathroom. Unfortunately, a certain guy was there too. "What time did you go to bed last night? You got up so soon!" Lin Zheng said with some surprise.
"5 o'clock sharp!" Yang Qi said inarticulately while brushing her teeth.
"You only slept for four hours! You are not afraid of dying young!" Lin Zheng squeezed out the toothpaste and brushed his teeth.
"In the early stages of the game, you can rest more later. Leveling up is the most important thing now. Only with a higher level will you have an advantage! I'm not an amateur like you. I have to consider the maximum profit!"
"Well - I don't care about that much anymore. I just go to sleep when I need to. By the way, after staying up all night, what level are you at?"
"Level 18, that Black Crow Sword is so awesome, otherwise I wouldn't be able to level up so high!" Yang Qi was excited again when talking about the Black Crow Sword. It is definitely a magic weapon at this stage!
"Damn, you got promoted so fast. Is this the difference between professionals and amateurs?" Lin Zheng was a little shocked. He was only level 12, and he had only played for more than an hour less than Yang Qi. There was actually a gap of 6 levels. This is unscientific!
"I'm not fast anymore. That Chongchong is a tough guy, and he's actually 21. Damn it! I have the Black Crow Sword! Does that guy have a weapon better than the Black Crow Sword?" Yang Qi looked confused, wondering how that Chongchong could level up so fast, but she soon felt relieved. Since Lin Zheng was lucky enough to get the Black Crow Sword, there was more than one lucky person in the world. After washing up, the two simply ran downstairs to fill their bellies, and then went online again.
As soon as it went online, Yang Qi contacted Lin Zheng.
"Shen Guan, do you want my sister to help you upgrade?" She knew that Lin Zheng was only level 12, and she was already level 18. With the Black Crow Sword in hand, it was very simple to take Lin Zheng to a few levels, but it would be slower to upgrade herself. Lin Zheng also thought of this. He was only an amateur and entered the game for the simple purpose of earning gold coins. It didn't matter if the level increased slowly, but Yang Qi did not simply do it to earn gold coins! So Lin Zheng refused and said: "Forget it, you can practice by yourself. I won't hold you back. You can lead me when the player's level is more stable. You can improve the level first. By the way, where are you?"
"What's going on here at the warehouse?"
"I happen to be going there too, wait for me! I have a lot of gold coins! I'll support you first, and you'll have to pay me back twice as much in the future!" Lin Zheng said with a smile. According to Lin Zheng's thinking, he can't spend all the gold coins he has for the time being. Instead of keeping them to become moldy and depreciate, it is better to support Yang Qi. When Yang Qi becomes prosperous, he will also benefit from it! Yang Qi was so poor now that her eyes immediately lit up when she heard that she had money. When Lin Zheng rushed to the warehouse to trade Yang Qi for 40 gold coins, his eyes were not shining but straight!
"Damn it! Where did you get so much money!?" Yang Qi asked in surprise. Are the rewards from the prop mission really so outrageous? That's just a prop mission in the Novice Village! But she forgot what Lin Zheng told her that the mission had become a compound mission, and the rewards had also changed a lot with the difficulty. But it feels good to have money! Yang Qi immediately beamed again. With 40 gold coins nearby, it would be much easier and safer to upgrade now!
"If you have the money, just take it. So much to say, but in other words, where is the best place to practice at level 12?" Lin Zheng asked while paying the money to apply for the warehouse.
"If you're at level 12, just go out of the city gate and go to Qingfeng Forest! But be careful, there are a lot of people PKing there, so you should choose a place with fewer people!"
"How many levels are you at? Someone is PKing with nothing. Isn't it painful to be idle!" Lin Zheng sounded a little agitated.Speechless, you lose a level once you die, why are those PK guys so idle? Lin Zheng didn't know what the PK party was thinking. After saying goodbye to Yang Qi, he went to the career hall. It was too late yesterday and he went offline without even finding a career mentor. He hasn't learned the skills yet.
After following the map and arriving at the door of the career hall, Lin Zheng was really amazed when he saw the majestic building in front of him! All are made of white marble! If this were true, this white marble alone would be enough to bankrupt many wealthy people! When you get into the game, there is a bunch of data in front of you.
Walking up the white stairs into the hall, the lively scene in front of him made Lin Zheng think that he had arrived at the talent market. Many people who were "interviewed" left in front of the professional mentor with a frustrated look on their faces, and some happily left the hall with weapons in hand. Listening to the complaints from those frustrated people, Lin Zheng finally understood that it was really difficult to go anywhere without money! There are also those who are too poor to even learn skills! Lin Zheng felt lucky for the gold coins he earned!
